notes.content: Admission to San José State is competitive in all majors. SJSU continues to have more qualified applicants than available new student spaces. Because of this, SJSU is an impacted campus with impacted programs. For the most current information regarding admission impaction at SJSU please visit our website Admissions Impaction . Prior to transferring to San José State University all transfers must earn at least 60 transferable semester units (90 quarter), including the CSU four basic skill courses required for CSU admission eligibility (except majors that have an approved CSU GE 1B waiver). Within those 60 semester/90 quarter units, students are strongly encouraged to complete the following: 1. Lower Division Major Course Requirements (especially for STEM Majors): Complete as many of the lower division courses required for the major as possible. Many of these courses may be double counted as part of the CSU GE 34 semester unit requirements. The lower division major courses for this major are shown below. 2. General Education (GE) Requirements: Complete all the CSU GE requirements at the community. The approved courses for each area can be found at ASSIST.org under the link for your college. Many of these courses may be double counted to meet the major requirements shown below, so choose your courses wisely. Some SJSU majors which meet GE requirements within the majors are noted on the Exceptions for University Graduation Requirements page in our catalog. Please see your college counselor or advisor to review your general education requirements before transferring to San José State University. 3. Second Course in English Composition highly recommended : All students are strongly encouraged to complete a second English composition course as part of their lower division GE prior to transferring to SJSU (either to meet CSU GE Area 1B or 3B). Complete this course with a grade of “C-” or better for the greatest success in passing a Writing in the Disciplines (100W) course with a “C” or better (C- not accepted) at SJSU. 4. American Institutions Requirement (US 1, US 2, and US 3 must be completed): This requirement is normally two courses and can be taken as part of your CSU GE requirements (Area 4 and sometimes Area 3). The approved courses can be found at ASSIST.org under the link "CSU US History, Constitution, and American Ideals Courses" for your college. 5. Physical Education (PE) Requirement: All undergraduate students who matriculate at SJSU are required to complete two units of physical education from Kinesiology/Dance activity courses, unless the major program has an approved PE waiver, or the student qualifies for an exemption based on veteran status. Majors which have approved PE waivers are noted on the " Exceptions for University Graduation Requirements " page in our catalog. Veterans may qualify for exemptions to the PE requirement; please see the Physical Education policy in the catalog for more information.
notes.contentHtml:
Admission to San José State is competitive in all majors. SJSU continues to have more qualified applicants than available new student spaces. Because of this, SJSU is an impacted campus with impacted programs. For the most current information regarding admission impaction at SJSU please visit our website Admissions Impaction. 

Prior to transferring to San José State University all transfers must earn at least 60 transferable semester units (90 quarter), including the CSU four basic skill courses required for CSU admission eligibility (except majors that have an approved CSU GE 1B waiver). Within those 60 semester/90 quarter units, students are strongly encouraged to complete the following: 

1. Lower Division Major Course Requirements (especially for STEM Majors): Complete as many of the lower division courses required for the major as possible. Many of these courses may be double counted as part of the CSU GE 34 semester unit requirements. The lower division major courses for this major are shown below. 

2. General Education (GE) Requirements: Complete all the CSU GE requirements at the community. The approved courses for each area can be found at ASSIST.org under the link for your college. Many of these courses may be double counted to meet the major requirements shown below, so choose your courses wisely. Some SJSU majors which meet GE requirements within the majors are noted on the Exceptions for University Graduation Requirements page in our catalog. Please see your college counselor or advisor to review your general education requirements before transferring to San José State University. 

3. Second Course in English Composition highly recommended: All students are strongly encouraged to complete a second English composition course as part of their lower division GE prior to transferring to SJSU (either to meet CSU GE Area 1B or 3B). Complete this course with a grade of “C-” or better for the greatest success in passing a Writing in the Disciplines (100W) course with a “C” or better (C- not accepted) at SJSU.

4. American Institutions Requirement (US 1, US 2, and US 3 must be completed): This requirement is normally two courses and can be taken as part of your CSU GE requirements (Area 4 and sometimes Area 3). The approved courses can be found at ASSIST.org under the link "CSU US History, Constitution, and American Ideals Courses" for your college. 

5. Physical Education (PE) Requirement: All undergraduate students who matriculate at SJSU are required to complete two units of physical education from Kinesiology/Dance activity courses, unless the major program has an approved PE waiver, or the student qualifies for an exemption based on veteran status. Majors which have approved PE waivers are noted on the "Exceptions for University Graduation Requirements" page in our catalog.  Veterans may qualify for exemptions to the PE requirement; please see the Physical Education policy in the catalog for more information.

notes.content: In order to be successful in this major you must complete the following articulated courses prior to transfer, earning grades of " C " or better on the first attempt. Students who struggle to achieve this should strongly consider selecting a different major. Please Note: All courses in the preparation and major (all courses in preparation and core) must be completed with a grade of "C-" or better. Specialized Courses - Students will choose one specialization from the the following: Flight Operations Professional Flight Aviation Management Maintenance Management – Airframes and Powerplants (A&P) : In order to complete the Maintenance Management - Airframes and Powerplants (A&P) option: a student must complete an AS-level FAA-approved Maintenance program from an accredited community college, prior to beginning upper division coursework. More information about this option may be found on the department's website: avtech.sjsu.edu Any course used to satisfy a major or minor requirement - including support courses, preparation courses, and prerequisites - must be taken for a letter grade (not Credit/No Credit).
